city.body: Ranjit Mathrani, the owner of Veeraswamy, is taking legal action against the Crown Estate over lease refusal. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.
